entities.summary: The Indo-Parthian kingdom, also known as Pahlavas or Pahlawas in ancient Sanskrit texts, was a synectric kingdom founded by Gondophares and was active from 19 CE to c. 226 CE. At its zenith, it ruled an area covering parts of eastern Iran, various parts of Afghanistan and the northwest regions of the Indian subcontinent. Its rulers may have been members of the House of Suren, and the kingdom has even been called the "Suren Kingdom" by some authors.
